# Current bundled producer records

These examples were emitted by the bundled Python producers with compact synthetic inputs. Network producers use synthetic transports; no external submissions were made. The mPTP failure uses a synthetic failed process and clock; Sanderson uses a complete synthetic native response. Native distance and delimitation records are emitted by the real engines. IQ-TREE recovery captures a failed publication and rollback. Sanger draft input includes native signal bounds. The protocol producer-format test checks the original key order, whitespace and final newline.

Every JSON file is registered in the protocol producer-format test. The distance crate checks the exact binary cache bytes. BLAST, mPTP failure and Sanderson reports sort keys explicitly so their dictionary construction order is not part of the format. These describe current formats only.
